exposure: history of COVID-19 during pregnancy or after childbirth
cohort: The study included 109 Jordanian mothers with a history of COVID-19 during pregnancy or after childbirth.
finding: The prevalence of postpartum depression was 67% among the studied mothers, and EPDS scores were positively correlated with being a smoker, delivery method, severe COVID-19 symptoms, and hospitalization.
mod_finding: Delivery method was found to have a positive statistically significant correlation with EPDS scores.
